title: EasyRadio
description: Minimalistik Radio Plugin, that have, waves, speak support, and more!
body:
## **EasyRadio**
**What does the plugin do?**
So the plugin adds a radio that really works, and looks vanilla.

**How to build a radio**
To build a radio player should build Redstone block, on redstone block set a Jukebox and on Jukebox set so much Lightning Rods that which Wave do player want to have, for example when player set only 1 Lightning Rod then the radio will be at 1st wave, when the player want to only hear radio this is enough, but when player also want to make sound to the radio, player should set a Lever on any side of Jukebox, so to finish the radio player should sit down and click with right click on the Jukebox, this is it, the radio is made, the player can hear all that is at the wave which he placed. So when player want to speak to the radio, player should pull the Lever on and speak with voice chat, all who have the same wave that this player will hear the player.
So when someone speaks on the Wave, no one more can speak at this wave until someone end speak. (When the Lever pulled on then This radio is speaking, this mean when player ended speak he should set Lever off)
![How should the Radio look like ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/332449b03cb52addbfffebaca1551995a0dcbeb0.jpeg)

## Commands:

(the /er and /easyradio command is the same )
1. /er wave (wave number) set sound (sound) = Set the sound at wave that you want.
2. /er wave (wave number) deletesound = Delete sound (When he was set) at wave that you want.
3. /er reload = reload the config

## Config:
```
# ==========================================
# EasyRadio Configuration
# ==========================================

messages:
  prefix: "&8[&bEasyRadio&8] &r"
  no_permission: "&cNo permission to use this command."
  config_reloaded: "&aEasyRadio configuration reloaded successfully."
  invalid_wave: "&cInvalid wave number. Please enter a valid number."
  sound_set: "&aServer sound &e%sound% &ais now playing on wave &b%wave%&a."
  sound_removed: "&aServer sound removed from wave &b%wave%&a."
  usage: "&eUsage: /er reload | /er wave <num> set sound <sound> | /er wave <num> deletesound"
  radio_created: "&aRadio successfully created! Tuned to wave: &b%wave%"
  radio_failed_reqs: "&cTo create a radio, you need a Redstone Block below, a Jukebox, and at least 1 Lightning Rod above!"
  radio_destroyed: "&cRadio destroyed!"
  rods_changed: "&eLightning rods changed. Shift+RightClick the radio to update the wave!"

settings:
  max_waves: 5
  max_server_radios: 50
  max_player_radios: 10
 ```
### Config Explain
"max_waves: " = How much waves do all radios have.
"max_player_radios: " = How much Radios can make 1 player.
"max_server_radios: " = How much Radios can be at the full server.

### Important:
1. Dependencies: Simple Voice Chat
2. Tested Version: 1.21.11
